name: crp002-spike
description: Logging prototype for the rich-presence project. Records how the app starts and stops this server. Uninstall after the spike.

privacy.title: Privacy level
privacy.description: A string with a default. Stands in for the real privacy setting.

discord_client_id.title: Discord application id
discord_client_id.description: Optional, no default. If set, the server sends one handshake to Discord and logs the reply type.

expose_tool.title: Expose the diagnostic tool
expose_tool.description: Off means the server lists no tools at all.

sample_number.title: Sample number
sample_number.description: Only here to see how a number arrives.

sample_secret.title: Sample secret
sample_secret.description: Optional. Type anything. Only its length is logged.

linger.title: Linger after the app closes the connection
linger.description: On means the server stays alive for 90 seconds after its input closes, to see whether something else ends it.
